notes.title: Theme Song “I Wanna Hear Your Voice” Instrumental Version Released for Free
notes.notes:
We are delighted to announce that we will be providing the instrumental version of our game's highly acclaimed theme song for you to download and use for free.

This music is a part of our game, and by offering this instrumental version, we aim to enable you to incorporate it into your creations, whether it be cover songs, remixes, or other forms of derivative works.

Please note that if you plan to use this music for derivative works, kindly attribute the source of the song when publishing. This will help protect copyright and also let others know where the music comes from.

We look forward to seeing how you use this music in your creations and anticipate your outstanding work!

Happy creating!

Noisy Fish Studio

notes.title: 28th March, Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone~

This is the official "Voice Love on Air" team.

We have some good news to share with you today!
"Voice Love on Air" will be released on 28th March at 10am (GMT +8), just under a week to go!

We apologize for making you wait for a week. In order to avoid any more delays this time, we decided to announce the new release date only after everything was settled.
Now everything is ready, we are just waiting for the release day! We are as excited as you are!

As previously announced, we will launch both the standard and deluxe editions on STEAM, with a two-week launch discount of 10% off for the standard edition.
Standard Edition: Original price $29.99, [b]with a launch discount of -10% (lasting for two weeks), discounted price $26.99[/b].
Deluxe Edition: Priced at $34.82. [b]Launch offer price (lasting for two weeks) $32.27[/b], including Game Artbook Collection (digital version) + Game Original Soundtrack Collection (containing 15 tracks).

[i]We look forward to meeting you in the game with Aki in a week. Get ready to start your own voice director story![/i]


Feel free to follow us to receive updates ↓↓↓

notes.title: Delayed Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear all players,

This is the official team of "Voice Love on Air."

Since the release of the first PV on Valentine's Day, followed by the DEMO at the end of February, up until this time nearing White Day, "Voice Love on Air" has received much anticipation and support from friends who are interested in our game. We have earnestly listened to everyone's valuable suggestions.

We sincerely appreciate all of you for giving us so much confidence to create this niche genre game. We have made thorough preparations, but we have encountered some issues during Valve's review process, and we are doing our best to solve them.

Therefore, we regret to inform everyone that the game will need to be postponed. The new release date will be announced soon.

On White Day, we will present the Lyrics MV of the game's full version theme song as a gift to everyone. Thank you for your anticipation and support, and please continue to stay tuned to "Voice Love on Air" by Softstar Entertainment.

notes.title: Let's become sound directors! The DEMO version is now online!
notes.notes:
After two weeks since the release of the first trailer, we apologize for the long wait!

[h3]The DEMO for 'Voice Love on Air,' a boys' love audio broadcast, is finally online![/h3]

The five characters previously revealed—Aki, Wesley, Ryousei, Junichi, and Yuuki —will all make appearances.

You can experience the recording of the first radio drama in the game, freely choose your favorite actors, and perform different voices. Each recording will bring a completely new experience!

The release date is approaching, so if you enjoy playing, please remember to add 'Voice Love on Air' to your wishlist.
